## 2. Misul Research Suite

Misul is an independent AI research lab in Sofia, Bulgaria. The lab builds machine intelligence from the principles of the brain: how it perceives, predicts, learns, and gives rise to mind. It designs new architectures from first principles rather than scaling existing methods.

### 2.1 Laplace
- **Scope**: Inference engine built from scratch exclusively for Apple Silicon.
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/MisulOrg/Laplace`
- **Core differentiator**: Target perf-per-watt (tokens per joule on laptop battery), not raw server throughput.
- **Architectural features**:
  - Custom NEON + DOTPROD + I8MM SIMD matmul kernels for common GGUF quantizations with scalar fallback.
  - Power-aware thread count and QoS policy with automatic battery and AC power modes.
  - **LaplaceKV**: K8/V6 sealed tiles, mutable FP32 tail, grouped-query attention, and SSD-backed streaming for bounded KV memory. At 65K context: 17.5 MiB active KV RAM vs 408 MiB resident 4-bit (23.3x active RAM reduction); 1.50 ms streamed attention (25% faster); 2.21x raw packed compression vs FP16.
  - **LaplaceMoE SSD streaming**: Runs MoE models larger than RAM by streaming expert weights on demand with a bounded resident set.
  - Speculative decoding: prompt-lookup and Jacobi-iteration lookahead.
  - Metal GPU backend with function-constant-specialized dequant kernels.
- **Model families supported**: Gemma 4 (MoE, hybrid attention, GeGLU), Llama 2/3, Mistral, Qwen2/Qwen2.5/Qwen3 dense, Qwen3-Next (hybrid attention + Gated DeltaNet), Phi-3 / Phi-3-mini.

### 2.2 Interlace
- **Scope**: Shared architecture for language and iterative computation.
- **Report**: `https://misul.org/Interlace`
- **Paper**: `https://github.com/MisulOrg/Interlace/blob/main/paper/interlace.pdf`
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/MisulOrg/Interlace`
- **Architecture**: A backbone that reuses its layers across successive computation steps, combining:
  1. Bounded rational feed-forward features.
  2. Content-selected attention over earlier rows.
  3. Gated delta recurrent memory.
  4. Shared depth with learned loop identifiers.
  5. Synchronous input, thought, and output streams.
- **Interfaces**: Text generation, synchronous streams, and experimental Flow-style refinement share one 29,814,640-parameter checkpoint.
- **30M comparison (single seed, common recipe)**: 9.86% lower WikiText-2 test loss and 65.7% less training execution time to a 5.5-nat validation-monitor target than a parameter-matched dense Transformer. Longer-program stream accuracy 80.47% vs 4.69% for the dense control.

### 2.3 Monodratic
- **Scope**: Open-source SSA-style (Sparse Self-Attention) causal sequence mixer and mathematical proof paper.
- **Report**: `https://misul.org/monodratic/`
- **Paper**: `https://github.com/MisulOrg/Monodratic/blob/main/output/pdf/monodratic_proof.pdf`
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/MisulOrg/Monodratic`
- **Key principles**:
  - Content-routed sparse attention: local windowed blocks plus a bounded set of earlier blocks selected by post-RoPE content routing.
  - Exact causal softmax computed over selected source tokens (no approximation error on the chosen subset).
  - OpenTM-PHI product-posting index with bounded causal posting lists.
- **Empirical validation (10 July 2026 report)**:
  - Associative-recall accuracy: 0.9909 mean, 0.9805 minimum over 3 seeds (routed width 2 of 5).
  - Minimum margin over local-only attention: 0.7070.
  - Selected-mask oracle error: 1.91 × 10^-6 maximum. Zero posting overflow.
  - 431 passed unit and integration tests.

## 3. Independent Projects

### 3.1 PhoneCode
- **Platform**: Android (Native).
- **Function**: On-device AI coding agent executing local neural models directly on mobile hardware. Provides private offline editing, repository inspection, and automated code transformations.

### 3.2 optiSYS
- **Platform**: Windows (Native x64/ARM64).
- **Function**: High-performance system optimizer and latency tuner. Reconfigures Windows scheduler heuristics, TCP/IP stack parameters, and memory page compression without background bloat or analytics telemetry.

### 3.3 dzipobel.wiki
- **Platform**: Web (High-speed static knowledge graph).
- **Function**: Curated literature and Bulgarian grammar repository for high-school students preparing for the state matriculation exams (DZI).

### 3.4 SchoolMap
- **Platform**: Web (Cloudflare Pages).
- **Function**: Fast interactive classroom projection mapping software built for dynamic geographic education.

## 4. Open Source Contributions

### 4.1 MoltenVK
- **Scope**: Porting Vulkan ray tracing to macOS inside MoltenVK, the Khronos Vulkan Portability implementation over Apple Metal.
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/KhronosGroup/MoltenVK`
- **Primary work**: `#2771` implements Vulkan ray tracing on macOS by mapping ray query, acceleration structures, and ray tracing pipelines onto Metal (`VK_KHR_acceleration_structure`, `VK_KHR_ray_query`, `VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline`).
- **Merged pull requests**:
  - `#2776` Add native sampler min/max filtering
  - `#2788` Avoid repeated state finalization for indexed indirect draws
  - `#2790` Avoid redundant non-indexed indirect draw finalization

## 5. Design & Engineering Standards

- **Curvature**: G3 squircle geometry using modern CSS `corner-shape: squircle` with SVG clip-path fallback.
- **Performance**: Strict avoidance of forced layout thrashing; 100% GPU-composited animations; sub-200ms tactile feedback.
- **Open Standards**: Fully compatible with Schema.org JSON-LD, OpenAPI, and LLM web-indexing protocols.
